body:
Maintainer approval recorded from the current review conversation on 2026-10-10:

- Approves the conditional ADR-0041 verification-row-7 erratum, with no ledger code change. PR #754 carries that correction. Rebooking a later event under a new transaction id remains a separate design decision.
- Approves the ADR-0015 wording reviewed in PRs #749 and #751, including “Order recorded”.
- Approves the listed ADR-0042 implementation deviations: five tables; a consistent five-key estimate; state responses for writes; list envelopes carrying as_of_source; optional supplied_days; entered dates limited to 1900–2200.

This approval does not declare verification complete. The refill-list/notices authorization race identified in review still needs a fix and regression tests. Native acceptance (#702) and integrated release verification (#703) remain separate gates. The duplicate ADR index cleanup merged in #753; the plan's stale approval and merge-status statements still need reconciliation.
